agent.measure: Retrofit processing, packaging and bulk storage lighting to LED high-bay + LED strip
agent.basis: 645k sf site with 65 ee, 2,210 hr/yr operation implies >400k sf of fig/raisin bulk and finished-goods warehouse lit 2,400 effective hrs. Existing 400W metal halide + T8 fluorescent ~260kW connected. LED to 0.28W/sf saves 310,000 kWh = 16.5% of 1,877,280 kWh @ $0.154/kWh. Net after PG&E $75/fixture rebate. Walk-through: count 380 high-bay + 210 8ft strips in paste / concentrate packing lines, measure lux, verify Title 24 compliance.

agent.measure: VFD / multiple-speed on dryer recirculation fans, evaporator and cooling tower fans/pumps
agent.basis: Raisin / fig tunnel dryers #1-4 use 6x 25-30HP axial recirculation fans + 2x 40HP fresh-air / exhaust fans, plus paste concentrate triple-effect evaporator vacuum pump and 60-ton evaporative condenser. Constant speed at 2,210 hr. Assume motors =55% of electricity. VFD with moisture-back-temperature control saves 15% on 60% of motor load =165,000 kWh = 8.8% of electricity. $1,200/HP installed.

agent.measure: Countercurrent cascade rinse for fig/raisin washers - reuse final rinse as first wash
agent.basis: CA food plant: water 16,061 kGal @ $2.43/kGal, disposal 12,551 kGal @ $2.44/kGal = $69,664/yr total water cost. Current single-pass washers for figs/raisins and crate washers dump to sewer. 3-tank countercurrent with conductivity control saves 20% water =3,212 kGal ($7,805) and 20% disposal =2,510 kGal ($6,123) =19.9% water stream, 20% disposal stream. Plus 5% gas for less hot wash water.

agent.measure: Waste heat from dryer flue / exhaust gases to preheat combustion air and boiler makeup water
agent.basis: 4 direct-fired natural gas fig tunnel dryers 120-150F, ~65,000 cfm total exhaust at 140-160F, 70% RH + 2x 4 MMBtu/hr Scotch-marine boilers for steam-jacketed fig paste cookers / concentrate pre-heaters / blanchers. Stack economizer + air-to-air plate exchanger: Preheat dryer fresh air 70F->115F and boiler makeup 60F->140F. Saves 1,900 MMBtu =12.0% of 15,860 MMBtu gas @ $6.27/MMBtu. Stainless exchanger needed for sugar/acid exhaust. Walk-through with stack T/RH and IR scan.

agent.measure: Eliminate leaks in compressed air lines / valves serving sorting, pitting, pneumatic convey and form-fill-seal
agent.basis: Packaging lines for raisins/paste/concentrate use 2x 50HP rotary screw @ 105 psig, 24/7 for blow-off, sorting tables, bagging. Food-grade audit typically finds 28-35% leak rate. Ultrasonic survey and repair to <10% saves 25% of compressed air load. Compressed air = ~18% of electricity =338,000 kWh, save 75,000 kWh =4.0% of electricity. Labor + fittings.

agent.measure: Occupancy sensors in intermittently occupied dry / cold storage, fig bins and restrooms
agent.basis: After LED, 645k sf warehouse: forklift aisles occupied <30% of shift. 35 PIR/ultrasonic high-bay sensors at $260 installed. Saves additional 70,000 kWh =3.7% of electricity (12.5% of warehouse lighting). Net of LED baseline - verify with logger. Prior IAC food group: 33% of plants flagged.

agent.measure: Insulate bare equipment: dryer shells/doors, steam-jacketed paste kettles, evaporator and 400ft steam header
agent.basis: Observed in walk-throughs: bare 350F dryer doors, 8x 500-gal paste cookers, concentrate evaporator body, condensate tank 180F. Surface loss 2,800 Btu/hr/sf x ~450 sf bare =1.26 MMBtu/hr x2,210 hr. Removable ceramic blanket jackets + 2in fiberglass on steam lines saves 950 MMBtu =6.0% gas ($5,958) + 6,000 kWh avoided refrigeration load in paste cold-room. $25/ft steam line + $750/kettle jacket.

agent.measure: Repair steam leaks, failed traps and increase condensate return on blancher/sterilizer circuit
agent.basis: Paste sterilization, fig blanching and crate wash use 30-80 psig steam. Typical 15 traps, 30% failed open. Return now 40%, target 70%. Fix traps, repack valves, insulate feedwater tank. Saves 800 MMBtu =5.0% gas ($5,018) + 500 kGal makeup water/disposal ($2,420) - trap cost $280 ea. Check with ultrasound + IR during operation.

agent.measure: Reduce compressed air header pressure and segregate low-pressure blow-off
agent.basis: Plant runs 105 psig for 90 psig actuators, but raisin destemmer blow-offs and box air-knives need only 15 psig. Lower header 105->85 psig saves ~1% per 2 psi =10% of compressed air =35,000 kWh =1.9% electricity, install dedicated 15HP low-pressure blower $2,400 + regulators.

agent.measure: Analyze flue gas and tune air/fuel on boilers + direct-fired dryer burners with O2 trim
agent.basis: 2 boilers + 4 dryer burners run with 6-9% O2 (40-70% excess air) without regular analyzer. Tune to 3% O2 for boilers, 4% for direct dryers, prevent scorching/browning defects on light figs. Portable combustion analyzer + linkageless control tweak saves 790 MMBtu =5.0% gas. Quarterly tuning schedule, train maintenance. $3,500 controls + $700 service.

agent.basis: Plastic bag plant uses compressed air for 6-8 blown-film air rings, corona treaters, pneumatic take-offs and flexo printers. Assume CA = 22% of 7,679,150 kWh electricity (1,689,413 kWh = $170,976 energy + $22,513 demand = $193,489/yr). Typical leak rate 25-30% of CA. Assume VFDs on 3x 40HP cooling tower fans, chilled water pumps and tower pumps save 30-35% of that subset = 4.1% of total electricity demand + energy.

agent.measure: RECOVER WASTE HEAT FROM EQUIPMENT
agent.basis: Recover 80% waste heat from 2x 100HP rotary screw air compressors (1,300h heating season) and extruder barrel cooling to heat makeup air/warehouse in MA winter. Assume displaces 38% of LPG heating load = 1,124 MMBtu of 2,957 MMBtu LPG ($22,509 at $20.03/MMBtu) plus 30 MMBtu electric unit heater savings = $16,850/yr.

agent.measure: REDUCE THE PRESSURE OF COMPRESSED AIR TO THE MINIMUM REQUIRED
agent.basis: Same CA system as 2.4236 = 22% of electricity ($193,489/yr). Plant set at 110 psig for 85 psig tools/printers. Assume reducing header to 95 psig and zoning printers at 90 psig saves 7% of CA energy per 10 psi (1% per 2 psi) = 6% of CA load = 1.32% of total electricity = ~101,365 kWh + 9 kW demand.

agent.measure: INSULATE BARE EQUIPMENT
agent.basis: 8 blown-film extruder barrels, dies at 350-420F, uninsulated heater bands and 60ft of exposed hot process piping. Assume extrusion heating = 12% of electricity (921,498 kWh = $93,256/yr). Insulating jackets save 10% of barrel heat loss + 15% of bare piping loss = 1.05% of total electricity + reduces cooling load on chillers.

agent.measure: UPGRADE CONTROLS ON COMPRESSORS
agent.basis: Assume 2-3 load/unload compressors serving bag machines with 40% part-load during nights/weekends (8,400h operation). Sequencer + pressure/flow controller to replace modulation saves 12% of CA electricity subset = 2.64% of CA = 0.58% of total electricity (44,593 kWh) plus $2,900 demand, vs. installing single 75HP VSD as trim.

agent.measure: USE MOST EFFICIENT TYPE OF ELECTRIC MOTORS
agent.basis: Extruder drives, granulators, printers use ~25 standard-efficiency 20-50HP motors rewound, 15% of electricity (1,151,873 kWh = $116,569/yr). Assume replacing 8 failed/rewound motors with NEMA Premium IE3 at next failure saves 4.5% of that motor subset = 0.68% of total electricity plus $900 demand, incremental cost over standard.

agent.measure: INSTALL OCCUPANCY SENSORS
agent.basis: Warehouse (40% of 118k sqft), ink room, break rooms, restrooms and offices lit 8,400h but occupied <50%. Assume 30% of LED lighting load (322,524 kWh) wasted = $32,639/yr subset. Occupancy sensors/daylight switching saves 35% of that wasted = 1.1% of total electricity after LED project, incremental to 2.7142.

agent.measure: OPTIMIZE PLANT POWER FACTOR
agent.basis: Electric demand = 13,644 kW-months = 1,137 kW avg, cost $102,332/yr at $7.50/kW-mo. Assume measured PF 0.84 from extruder DC drives/large motors, penalty below 0.95. Assume 150 kVAR capacitor bank corrects to 0.96, saves 4.1% of demand charges = $4,200/yr plus 1% I2R loss on feeders, no kWh savings.
